chunks: And as for the right of the mu'adhdhin, it is that you know that he is reminding you of your Lord, calling you to your good fortune, and helping you to accomplish what God has made obligatory upon you, so thank him for that just as you thank one who does good to you.

key_terms.حَقُّ الْمُؤَذِّنِ: Right of the caller to prayer

ai.seo_question: What are the rights of the mu'adhdhin according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin elevates the mu'adhdhin from a mere announcer to a spiritual facilitator who actively aids the believer in fulfilling divine obligations, framing the call to prayer as a continuous act of communal worship. This right emphasizes the social dimension of gratitude (shukr), requiring believers to acknowledge the mu'adhdhin’s service with the same reverence shown to a benefactor, thereby reinforcing the communal bonds of the Ummah. The instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on recognizing the subtle spiritual contributions of individuals who enable collective ritual practice.
